messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Studiuje chemię w Lublinie i prowadzi korepetycje; zagląda tu późnym wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: ceramika użytkowa, makaron z patelni, gry karciane
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: punkt ksero przy ulicy Sowińskiego w Lublinie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przygotowuje się do zaliczeń i uczy się robić naczynia na cotygodniowych warsztatach.
- sposób pisania: zdania: long run-on; interpunkcja: wiele wielokropków i nawiasów; wielkie litery: mostly standard, lowercase starts; literówki: rare; skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: rare
- tik językowy: wplata „w sumie to”

For each of the 19 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. technologia i sprzęt - drukarka (late morning, Friday)
2. zakupy i ceny - nowe buty / kurtka (lunch break, Saturday)
3. praca i grafik - szef / współpracownik, drobna sytuacja bez konfliktu (evening, Friday)
4. zakupy i ceny - zwrot / reklamacja (bez gniewu, drobne) (late night, Saturday)
5. sport - bieganie, pierwsza 5/10 km (early morning, Sunday)
6. drobne narzekanie na usługi - urząd, kolejka, numerek (early morning, Monday)
7. dzieci i rodzina - wakacje, planowanie (evening, Wednesday)
8. sport - skoki narciarskie / siatkówka / żużel w TV (early morning, Sunday)
9. zakupy i ceny - nowe buty / kurtka (afternoon, Saturday)
10. pogoda - zmiana pogody vs plany (lunch break, Tuesday)
11. jedzenie i gotowanie - śniadanie w biegu (lunch break, Sunday)
12. gry i seriale - maraton serialu, zarwana noc (afternoon, Monday)
13. komunikacja i dojazdy - kontrola biletów (morning commute, Wednesday)
14. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (late night, Wednesday)
15. praca i grafik - pierwszy dzień po urlopie (early morning, Wednesday)
16. remont i dom - szukanie fachowca (afternoon, Tuesday)
17. zakupy i ceny - drogi prąd / gaz, rachunek (morning commute, Sunday)
18. zakupy i ceny - paczkomat, odbiór (late night, Tuesday)
19. zwierzęta - weterynarz, szczepienie (late morning, Tuesday)

Return a JSON array of 19 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
